runs.emptyBody: Runs show up here once a CI job can actually reach this studio — the target repo needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY, GITHUB_TOKEN and DEVDIGEST_INGEST_TOKEN set as Actions secrets, and this studio's ingest URL must be reachable from GitHub's runners. A repo missing any of those reviews every PR and reports nothing.
runs.title: CI Runs
runs.subtitle: Agent reviews executed inside CI · not local runs

exportWizard.title: Export to CI
exportWizard.subtitle: Run {agentName} automatically on pull requests
exportWizard.targetDisabledReason: Not available yet — only GitHub Actions is generated in this release.
exportWizard.repoHint: owner/name — the repo to add the workflow to
exportWizard.repoInvalid: Must look exactly like owner/name — letters, digits, - . _ only, one slash.
exportWizard.selectFilePrompt: Select a file to view its contents.
exportWizard.runnerFileNote: Not shown here — the real bundle is embedded server-side at Install; it is never uploaded or downloaded through the wizard.
exportWizard.memoryFileNote: Reserved placeholder — nothing currently reads this file.
exportWizard.workflowEditHint: Plain text. Hand-edit if this repo needs something different — no structured form, no as-you-type validation, no diff view. DevDigest re-validates it server-side before committing.

triggers.openedCost: Runs once, when the PR is opened.
triggers.synchronizeCost: Runs on every push to an open PR — the most frequent trigger.
triggers.reopenedCost: Runs when a closed PR is reopened.

exportWizard.blockMergeDesc: DevDigest turns the check red on a matching finding, via the agent's Fail CI on setting. Making red actually block a merge is a required status check in the target repo's branch protection — configured by the repo owner, in GitHub, by hand. No GitHub App is involved either way.
exportWizard.ingestUrlHint: Where the CI job POSTs its result back to this studio.
exportWizard.ingestUrlLocalhostWarning: This points at localhost — a GitHub Actions runner cannot reach it. Use a publicly reachable URL for this studio before installing.

secretsPanel.title: Secrets expected
secretsPanel.disclaimer: DevDigest cannot read, set or verify a repository secret. This is a checklist for you to complete in the repo's GitHub settings, not a live check.
secretsPanel.ingestTokenStatus: DevDigest generates this at Install — you paste it in

exportWizard.providerNotice: This agent's studio provider is {provider}, but the CI runner always calls OpenRouter — the model string "{model}" will be sent to OpenRouter verbatim.
exportWizard.installCardTitle: Open a PR with these files
exportWizard.installCardBody: DevDigest opens a PR in {repo} titled “Add DevDigest CI review” with the {count} generated files.
exportWizard.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo's Actions secrets before the workflow runs.
exportWizard.zipCardBody: Download the generated files and add them to the repo yourself. This path makes no GitHub write.
exportWizard.zipCardNoToken: No ingest token is issued on this path — CI Runs won't show results for this repo until you install via the pull-request path instead.
exportWizard.conflictTitle: A different agent is already installed here

tokenBlock.title: DevDigest ingest token
tokenBlock.warning: Shown once — copy it now and paste it into the repo's Actions secrets as DEVDIGEST_INGEST_TOKEN. It cannot be shown again after this dialog closes.

ciTab.heading: Continuous Integration
ciTab.subtitle: Run this agent automatically on pull requests in a target repo.
ciTab.empty: Not deployed to CI yet. Use “Publish to CI” to open a PR that adds the workflow + agent config.
ciTab.emptyBody: Export this agent to run automatically on pull requests via GitHub Actions.
ciTab.failOnNote: Affects CI only after the manifest is re-exported — this value reaches CI through the committed manifest, never live.
ciTab.tokenPreservedNote: Your existing ingest token is preserved — no need to update the repo's secret.
ciTab.driftBanner: Running an older configuration: this repo has v{installedVersion}, the agent is now v{currentVersion}.
ciTab.removeConfirmBody: The committed workflow in {repo} keeps running — its reports will start being rejected (401) once removed, until you install again or delete the workflow file yourself.

publishDialog.title: Publish to CI
publishDialog.subtitle: Run {agentName} on every pull request in {repo}
publishDialog.intro: Opens a pull request in {repo} adding a GitHub Actions workflow + this agent's config under .devdigest/. On every PR the agent reviews the diff.
publishDialog.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo's Actions secrets before the workflow runs. GITHUB_TOKEN is provided automatically.
publishDialog.doneBody: Opened/updated a pull request in {repo} with the workflow + agent config.
